news.title: Full year 2026 earnings released: EPS: ₹25.98 (vs ₹20.11 in FY 2025)
news.body: Full year 2026 results: EPS: ₹25.98 (up from ₹20.11 in FY 2025). Revenue: ₹62.7b (up 15% from FY 2025). Net income: ₹25.1b (up 29% from FY 2025). Profit margin: 40% (up from 36% in FY 2025). The increase in margin was driven by higher revenue. Revenue is forecast to grow 6.3% p.a. on average during the next 3 years, compared to a 1.4% growth forecast for the Banks industry in India. Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has increased by 24% per year but the company’s share price has increased by 56% per year, which means it is tracking significantly ahead of earnings growth.
